title: Sealed work order acceptance gate verification
objective: Verify that sealed work orders have acceptance gates and that those gates are documented with id, description, and pass_criteria.

source.reference: AG-PREP-1 through AG-PREP-6, AG-COPY-1 through AG-COPY-8
source.description: Every sealed work packet must define acceptance gates with the triple pattern (id, description, pass_criteria)

execution.criteria: Each sealed work packet JSON in packets/ has an acceptance_gates array with non-zero length
execution.expected_outcome: All sealed packets have acceptance_gates with valid structure

pass_criteria.description: All work packet JSONs have acceptance_gates array
Each gate has id, description, and pass_criteria
All sealed work orders pass their acceptance gates
